confidence_notes: Frankfurt restaurant anchors use current aggregated cost-of-living prices; the cocktail estimate is based on a small crowdsourced sample, wine is inferred at about 1.5 times the local draft-beer price, and accommodation prices are broad model estimates that can rise sharply during trade fairs.
